notes.title: Version 1.14.5 Released
notes.notes:
Fix Ultrites to improve crit multiplier instead of crit chance twice
    Fix room crash in Patriarch
    Fix room crash in tutorial
    Improve friend and faction messages
    Add /score chat command to see score of current shell
    Add /who chat command lists players on the current map
    Make Bolt Thrower shot a little more powerful and explosion a little less powerful, show both stats in tooltip
    Add trisected mod to Bolt Thrower
    Allow standing on phone booth on Eschaton
    Slightly improve Delites
    Upgrade soundjs library
    Slightly increase min damage of Needlebow and Stonebow
    Reduce Magonel and Scorpion fire rate and range a bit
    Add fire rate mod to Magonel and Scorpion
    Rename mods to Armor Piercing and Precise
    Remove radius mod on Trinity and Volta
    Add crit chance mod to Trinity and Volta
    Don't allow New Sparks to emote
    Various performance optimizations
    Game will attempt to reconnect to in-use character even after game is shut down

notes.title: StarBreak 1.12.1 patch is live
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes:

General
  
  Fix bug that could cause certain projectiles intended to be blockable to become unblockable 
  
New Zone the Frozen Blight! (both normal and elite variants) 
  
  New Exotic weapons to find and use!
  
Fire Forest (both variants)
  
  Add the winning contest submission
  
Graveyard
  
  Boss
  
      Bomb rovers are not destroyed on damage and should not create explosions after they are destroyed
  
  
More features and content coming soon!

-Crunchy Games Team

notes.title: StarBreak 1.10.1 patch is live
notes.notes:
General

Improve recommendation arrow
Make invulnerability time more consistent (large lag should not impact invulnerability timer)
Update level on zone complete (instead of after leaving zone)
Maximum number of zone completions higher for elite variants than normal variants
Add NPC to somewhere added last patch

Duskwing

Increase Balefire Skein damage and DoT lifetime

Fabricator

Fix incorrect frames on Macron timer
Fix macron emit edge case

Fire Forest

New Fire Forest floors and zone configurations

Fungus Cave

Make darter collision box better match its art

Underground Base

Reduce top speed of rocketeer rockets (should help them feel for fair in the Boss and Wave Rooms)

Strands

Fix stitching issues with certain ledges
Fix door in the Strands Connector (elite variant only)

notes.title: Version 1.5.3 is now live!
notes.notes:
General

Improve network efficiency
Make 0 and O more discernible
Add movement speed implants
Add knockback resist implants
Recommendation arrow is now on the player (hopefully this will better guide new players to level appropriate zones)
Recommendation arrow can be turned off in settings
Modify certain tips

Fabricator

Macrons now give a better indication of when they will self-destruct
Macrons now have 3 sec lifetime with a mod of +1 second
Add Blink (Exotic Macron)

Vanquished
  
Boss

Reduce armor of troop transports in normal mode slightly and increase armor in elite mode slightly
Troop transports are now properly phased


Underground Base

Fix issue that could cause no Midbosses to spawn in elite variants
No HP drops after wave 50 in wave room

Strands

Fix something about someplace

Graveyard

Boss

Scavengers have a much larger aggro radius in the boss room than in other parts of the Graveyard



More features and content coming soon!

-Crunchy Games Team

notes.title: StarBreak 1.4 patch is live
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Here are the patch notes for version 1.4, which is now live:

General

Improve network efficiency
Improve database writing
Clear input when opening a menu (should prevent shells from running in a given direction when you open a menu while running)
Rate limit input (auto key repeat no longer allowed)
Fix issue with controller sticking
Player and ally ships are different colors somewhere
More hats!

Ironclad

Hammer swing SFX will not play for other players

Fungus Cave

Improve performance of Darter Spawners

Graveyard

Fix issue that caused doors to appear to be hovering

Star Cathedral

Spirit Hive now does touch damage

More features and content coming soon!

-Crunchy Games Team

notes.title: Version 1.2 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Version 1.2 is live today!

[code]
- General
  - XP now gained immediately from completing missions
  - Animation plays when mission is complete
  - Players are invulnerable after a mission is completed until they leave that map
  - Server is now more robust to some errors
  - Add new hats
  - Temporarily lower mission player cap to 40
  - Limit length of ticks on client
  - Add something to somewhere
  - Add a different but similar something to somewhere else
- Steam client
  - OpenGL drivers without the ability to adjust VSync will now work
- Star Cathedral
  - You can only enter one portal, if you home out, you can not reenter
  - Portal will stay open for 20 minutes
  - Annoucement of opening more obvious
- Temple of the Lost
  - More ledges at the top of the boss room
- Strands
  - Move boss map entrance to the top of the map and slightly increase invul time
- Vanquished
  - Crystals will no longer trap Ironclads
- Loot
  - Ammo pickups will say accurate numbers when using Bandoliers
- Duskwing
  - Can now change direction and crouching while doing standing attacks
- Fabricator
  - Make Mechanized Macron move when used on platform
  - Falling will not interrupt drone summoning 
[/code]

More features and content coming soon!

-Crunchy Games Team
